rationale: A 44-year-old male traveler returning from Kenya presenting with prolonged fever, hepatosplenomegaly, severe thrombocytopenia, pancytopenia, and secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH). Wright-stained bone marrow aspirates demonstrated intracellular oval yeast-like cells suggestive of H. capsulatum, with repeat aspirate showing extensive intrahistiocytic and extracellular H. capsulatum yeasts. Fungal culture on Sabouraud dextrose agar showed thermal dimorphism (cottony mold at 28 C and yeast-like colonies at 37 C) with tuberculate macroconidia, and species identity was definitively confirmed as Histoplasma capsulatum via PCR targeting ITS1-4, ARF, H-antigen, OLE, and M-antigen genes (GenBank ON244035). Successfully treated with amphotericin B followed by itraconazole with complete recovery. Confirmed active histoplasmosis (E1 confirmatory histology, culture, and PCR) -> POSITIVE.

rationale: A 71-year-old female from Ecuador with rheumatoid arthritis on immunosuppressants presented with acute-on-chronic right knee prosthetic joint infection (PJI). Initial synovial fluid aspiration bacterial culture grew Listeria monocytogenes, while synovial fluid fungal media culture subsequently retrieved 2 colony-forming units (CFUs) of Histoplasma capsulatum, confirming fungal prosthetic joint coinfection (E1 confirmatory evidence).
